metadata.purpose: Seed/reference data for Policy Management, Scheme Management, Search and Eligibility Checker
metadata.id_mapping_note: policy_reference and scheme_reference are temporary JSON identifiers. Map scheme_reference to PostgreSQL-generated scheme_id when importing eligibility_rules. Do not insert these reference strings into BIGSERIAL ID columns.
metadata.eligibility_note: Eligibility fields are limited to the existing eligibility_rules schema. Conditions that cannot be represented safely by min_age, max_age, gender, max_income, occupation, education, state, social_category and disability_status are not guessed.
metadata.logo_note: No logo fields are added because the existing database schema is unchanged. Logos can be mapped in the frontend using scheme/policy references or names.
metadata.verification_note: Government source URLs were used for verification/reference. Four source URLs were corrected for POL002, SCH015, SCH017 and SCH021; recheck scheme guidelines before production use because government eligibility rules can change.

schemes.name: Pradhan Mantri Kisan Samman Nidhi (PM-KISAN)
schemes.description: Central Sector scheme providing income support to eligible landholding farmer families.
schemes.ministry: Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare
schemes.department: Department of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare
schemes.benefits: ₹6,000 per year in three equal instalments, subject to scheme conditions.
schemes.documents_required: Aadhaar details, bank account details and landholding/farmer registration information as applicable.
schemes.application_process: Registration and eKYC through the official PM-KISAN system and State/UT authorities.

schemes.name: Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana - Urban 2.0 (PMAY-U 2.0)
schemes.description: Urban housing mission providing assistance to eligible families under notified housing verticals.
schemes.ministry: Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs
schemes.benefits: Housing assistance under the applicable PMAY-U 2.0 vertical, subject to scheme conditions.
schemes.documents_required: Aadhaar, identity/residential proof, income proof and component-specific documents.
schemes.application_process: Online registration through the official PMAY-U 2.0 system followed by eligibility verification and beneficiary survey.

schemes.name: Ayushman Bharat - Pradhan Mantri Jan Arogya Yojana (AB-PMJAY)
schemes.description: Government health assurance scheme providing cashless hospitalization services to eligible poor and vulnerable families.
schemes.ministry: Ministry of Health and Family Welfare
schemes.benefits: Cashless hospitalization coverage up to ₹5 lakh per family per year for eligible beneficiaries.
schemes.documents_required: Beneficiary identification and verification documents as required.
schemes.application_process: Check eligibility through the official beneficiary system and access services at empanelled hospitals.

schemes.name: Pradhan Mantri Ujjwala Yojana (PMUY)
schemes.description: Scheme providing deposit-free LPG connections to eligible adult women from poor households.
schemes.ministry: Ministry of Petroleum and Natural Gas
schemes.department: Ministry of Petroleum and Natural Gas
schemes.benefits: LPG connection support and applicable assistance under the scheme.
schemes.documents_required: Aadhaar, address proof, bank account details and LPG KYC documents as applicable.
schemes.application_process: Apply through an LPG distributor or the official PMUY process.

schemes.name: Sukanya Samriddhi Account
schemes.description: Government-backed small-savings account designed for the financial future of a girl child.
schemes.ministry: Ministry of Finance
schemes.benefits: Government-backed savings with applicable interest and tax treatment under prevailing rules.
schemes.documents_required: Girl child's birth certificate and guardian identity/address documents as applicable.
schemes.application_process: Open the account through an authorised bank or post office.

schemes.name: Pradhan Mantri Mudra Yojana (PMMY)
schemes.description: Credit scheme supporting eligible micro and small business activities through institutional lending.
schemes.ministry: Ministry of Finance
schemes.benefits: Institutional credit under applicable MUDRA loan categories, subject to lender and scheme conditions.
schemes.documents_required: KYC, business and financial documents required by the lending institution.
schemes.application_process: Approach participating banks, NBFCs or MFIs and apply for eligible MUDRA credit.

schemes.name: PM Street Vendor's AtmaNirbhar Nidhi (PM SVANidhi)
schemes.description: Micro-credit scheme supporting eligible street vendors with working-capital loans and incentives.
schemes.ministry: Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs
schemes.department: Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs
schemes.benefits: Working-capital credit support with incentives subject to current scheme rules.
schemes.documents_required: Street-vendor identification/certificate or letter of recommendation and KYC documents as applicable.
schemes.application_process: Apply through the official PM SVANidhi portal or designated lending institutions.

schemes.name: PM Vishwakarma
schemes.description: Central Sector scheme supporting traditional artisans and craftspeople through recognition, training, toolkit and credit support.
schemes.ministry: Ministry of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises
schemes.department: Ministry of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises
schemes.benefits: Certificate and ID, skill training, toolkit incentive, credit support and marketing assistance subject to eligibility.
schemes.documents_required: Aadhaar and registration/verification documents required by the scheme.
schemes.application_process: Registration is facilitated through Common Service Centres and the official PM Vishwakarma system.

schemes.name: Stand-Up India
schemes.description: Bank-loan facilitation scheme supporting eligible women and SC/ST entrepreneurs for greenfield enterprises.
schemes.ministry: Ministry of Finance
schemes.benefits: Composite bank loans generally from ₹10 lakh to ₹1 crore for eligible greenfield enterprises.
schemes.documents_required: KYC, business plan and financial documents required by the lending institution.
schemes.application_process: Apply through a participating bank or the Stand-Up India portal.

schemes.name: Pradhan Mantri Matru Vandana Yojana (PMMVY)
schemes.description: Maternity benefit programme providing cash assistance to eligible pregnant women and lactating mothers under notified conditions.
schemes.ministry: Ministry of Women and Child Development
schemes.department: Ministry of Women and Child Development
schemes.benefits: Maternity benefit assistance under the applicable PMMVY guidelines.
schemes.documents_required: Aadhaar and bank account details plus pregnancy and other supporting documents as applicable.
schemes.application_process: Apply through designated Anganwadi centres or the official PMMVY system.

schemes.name: Atal Pension Yojana (APY)
schemes.description: Government-backed pension scheme for eligible subscribers with a savings bank/post-office account.
schemes.ministry: Ministry of Finance
schemes.benefits: Guaranteed minimum pension options after the prescribed pension age, subject to contribution conditions.
schemes.documents_required: Savings account, Aadhaar/KYC and other enrolment details required by the participating institution.
schemes.application_process: Enrol through a participating bank or post office.

schemes.name: Pradhan Mantri Jan-Dhan Yojana (PMJDY)
schemes.description: National financial inclusion programme providing access to basic banking and financial services.
schemes.ministry: Ministry of Finance
schemes.benefits: Access to basic banking services, RuPay card and applicable overdraft/insurance features.
schemes.documents_required: Officially accepted identity/address documents as required by the bank.
schemes.application_process: Open an eligible basic savings bank deposit account through a participating bank or banking outlet.

schemes.name: Pradhan Mantri Jeevan Jyoti Bima Yojana (PMJJBY)
schemes.description: Renewable one-year term life insurance scheme offered through participating banks/post offices and insurers.
schemes.ministry: Ministry of Finance
schemes.benefits: ₹2 lakh life cover for eligible enrolled subscribers, subject to scheme terms.
schemes.documents_required: Eligible bank/post-office account and KYC/enrolment consent.
schemes.application_process: Enrol through a participating bank/post office with auto-debit consent.

schemes.name: Pradhan Mantri Suraksha Bima Yojana (PMSBY)
schemes.description: Renewable personal accident insurance scheme for eligible bank/post-office account holders.
schemes.ministry: Ministry of Finance
schemes.benefits: Accident insurance benefits up to ₹2 lakh depending on the covered event and scheme terms.
schemes.documents_required: Eligible bank/post-office account and KYC/enrolment consent.
schemes.application_process: Enrol through a participating bank or post office with auto-debit consent.

schemes.name: Pradhan Mantri Kaushal Vikas Yojana (PMKVY)
schemes.description: Skill development programme supporting industry-relevant training, assessment and certification for eligible candidates.
schemes.ministry: Ministry of Skill Development and Entrepreneurship
schemes.benefits: Skill training, assessment and certification through approved programmes.
schemes.documents_required: Identity and educational/supporting documents as required by the training centre.
schemes.application_process: Register through approved training centres or official skill-development channels.

schemes.name: National Apprenticeship Promotion Scheme (NAPS)
schemes.description: Programme promoting apprenticeship training by supporting employers and apprentices under applicable guidelines.
schemes.ministry: Ministry of Skill Development and Entrepreneurship
schemes.benefits: Government support for apprenticeship engagement and training according to applicable guidelines.
schemes.documents_required: Identity, educational and bank details required for apprenticeship registration.
schemes.application_process: Register and apply for apprenticeship opportunities through the official apprenticeship portal.

schemes.name: PM-USP Central Sector Scheme of Scholarship for College and University Students
schemes.description: Merit-cum-means scholarship providing financial assistance to eligible students pursuing regular higher-education courses.
schemes.ministry: Ministry of Education
schemes.benefits: Annual scholarship assistance under the notified scholarship rules.
schemes.documents_required: Academic records, income certificate and bank/Aadhaar-linked details as required.
schemes.application_process: Apply through the National Scholarship Portal during the notified period.

schemes.name: Post-Matric Scholarship for Scheduled Caste Students
schemes.description: Scholarship support for eligible Scheduled Caste students studying at post-matriculation levels.
schemes.ministry: Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment
schemes.department: Department of Social Justice and Empowerment
schemes.benefits: Financial assistance under applicable academic and maintenance components.
schemes.documents_required: Caste certificate, income certificate, academic documents and bank details as required.
schemes.application_process: Apply through the National Scholarship Portal or designated State/UT scholarship system.

schemes.name: Pre-Matric Scholarship for Scheduled Caste Students
schemes.description: Scholarship support for eligible Scheduled Caste students at specified pre-matric levels.
schemes.ministry: Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment
schemes.department: Department of Social Justice and Empowerment
schemes.benefits: Scholarship assistance according to applicable class and scheme guidelines.
schemes.documents_required: Caste certificate, income certificate, school and bank details as required.
schemes.application_process: Apply through the designated scholarship portal or State/UT system.

schemes.name: PM YASASVI Scholarship Scheme
schemes.description: Scholarship support for eligible students from OBC, EBC and DNT communities under notified components.
schemes.ministry: Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment
schemes.department: Department of Social Justice and Empowerment
schemes.benefits: Scholarship assistance under applicable PM YASASVI components and guidelines.
schemes.documents_required: Category, income, academic and identity documents as required.
schemes.application_process: Apply through the National Scholarship Portal or notified scholarship/examination process.

schemes.name: National Means-cum-Merit Scholarship Scheme (NMMSS)
schemes.description: Scholarship scheme supporting meritorious students from economically weaker families to continue secondary education.
schemes.ministry: Ministry of Education
schemes.department: Department of School Education and Literacy
schemes.benefits: ₹12,000 per year for selected scholarship recipients, subject to scheme rules.
schemes.documents_required: Academic records, income certificate, identity and bank details as required.
schemes.application_process: Apply through the National Scholarship Portal and complete the notified selection process.

schemes.name: Pradhan Mantri Kisan Urja Suraksha evam Utthaan Mahabhiyan (PM-KUSUM)
schemes.description: Programme promoting solar energy use in agriculture, including decentralised renewable power and solarisation of agricultural pumps.
schemes.ministry: Ministry of New and Renewable Energy
schemes.department: Ministry of New and Renewable Energy
schemes.benefits: Support for eligible solar agricultural and decentralised renewable-energy components under scheme guidelines.
schemes.documents_required: Farmer/land, identity, bank and component-specific documents as required.
schemes.application_process: Apply through the designated State/UT implementing agency for the relevant component.

schemes.name: Pradhan Mantri Fasal Bima Yojana (PMFBY)
schemes.description: Crop insurance scheme providing financial protection to eligible farmers against specified crop losses and risks.
schemes.ministry: Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare
schemes.department: Department of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare
schemes.benefits: Crop insurance protection against notified risks and losses for notified crops and areas.
schemes.documents_required: Land/cultivation records, Aadhaar and bank details as applicable.
schemes.application_process: Enrol through notified banks, insurers, Common Service Centres or the official crop insurance system.

schemes.name: Kisan Credit Card (KCC)
schemes.description: Credit facility enabling eligible farmers and agricultural/allied activity participants to meet working-capital needs.
schemes.ministry: Ministry of Finance
schemes.benefits: Timely agricultural and allied-activity credit subject to lending norms.
schemes.documents_required: KYC and land/cultivation or allied-activity documents required by the lender.
schemes.application_process: Apply through participating banks and eligible financial institutions.

schemes.name: Pradhan Mantri Employment Generation Programme (PMEGP)
schemes.description: Credit-linked subsidy programme supporting eligible new micro-enterprises and self-employment ventures.
schemes.ministry: Ministry of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises
schemes.benefits: Margin-money subsidy support linked to eligible project financing under PMEGP guidelines.
schemes.documents_required: Identity, project report, educational and financial documents as required.
schemes.application_process: Apply online through the official PMEGP/KVIC process and participating financing institutions.

schemes.name: Pradhan Mantri Awaas Yojana - Gramin (PMAY-G)
schemes.description: Rural housing programme providing assistance to eligible rural households for construction of pucca houses with basic amenities.
schemes.ministry: Ministry of Rural Development
schemes.benefits: Housing assistance for eligible rural households under PMAY-G guidelines.
schemes.documents_required: Household, identity, bank and rural housing verification documents as applicable.
schemes.application_process: Beneficiaries are identified through the prescribed rural housing selection process and State/UT implementation.

schemes.name: Pradhan Mantri Dakshta Aur Kushalta Sampann Hitgrahi (PM-DAKSH)
schemes.description: Skill-development programme for eligible marginalized groups including SC, OBC, EWS, DNT and sanitation workers/waste pickers.
schemes.ministry: Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment
schemes.department: Department of Social Justice and Empowerment
schemes.benefits: Skill training, stipends where applicable and support for employability/self-employment.
schemes.documents_required: Nationality, Aadhaar/identity, category and income documents as applicable.
schemes.application_process: Register through the official skill-development platform and approved training channels.

schemes.name: Pradhan Mantri Matsya Sampada Yojana (PMMSY)
schemes.description: Fisheries-sector programme supporting sustainable fisheries development, infrastructure, productivity and fisher welfare.
schemes.ministry: Ministry of Fisheries, Animal Husbandry and Dairying
schemes.benefits: Financial and developmental support for eligible fisheries activities under notified components.
schemes.documents_required: Identity, fisheries activity/project and component-specific documents prescribed by implementing authorities.
schemes.application_process: Apply through the designated State/UT fisheries department or implementing agency.

schemes.name: National Social Assistance Programme (NSAP)
schemes.description: Social assistance programme comprising pension and family-benefit components for eligible vulnerable persons and households.
schemes.ministry: Ministry of Rural Development
schemes.benefits: Assistance under applicable NSAP components such as old-age, widow, disability and family-benefit support.
schemes.documents_required: Age, identity, residence, household/income and component-specific documents as required by the State/UT.
schemes.application_process: Apply through the designated State/UT local-government or social-welfare channel.

schemes.name: Deendayal Antyodaya Yojana - National Rural Livelihoods Mission (DAY-NRLM)
schemes.description: Rural livelihoods programme supporting women-led self-help groups and sustainable livelihood opportunities for rural poor households.
schemes.ministry: Ministry of Rural Development
schemes.benefits: Support through self-help groups, financial inclusion, skills and livelihood-promotion activities.
schemes.documents_required: SHG/member records and documents required by State Rural Livelihood Missions.
schemes.application_process: Access is facilitated through State Rural Livelihood Missions, self-help groups and local implementing institutions.

eligibility_rules.education: As prescribed for the training/job role
Class VIII/IX and onward as prescribed
